assumptions: No qualified Thai reference exists; no Mae Sai accuracy is claimed.
The 15 September acquisition is roughly four days after the 11 September peak and therefore shows residual extent.
Models and calibration were fitted to C2S-MS GRD; RTC gamma0 is a preprocessing shift.
C2S-MS-derived metrics describe C2S-MS only, never Mae Sai.
Water includes permanent water; this is not independently labelled new inundation.
Candidate report-only outputs cannot feed exposure, roads, access, equity or FPPS.
Uncertainty is normalized binary entropy, not an independently verified error probability.
Terrain is calculated in 512-pixel tiles with 128-pixel context buffers; edge tiles are smaller.
Context abstention uses WorldCover built-up and an unvalidated potential-shadow heuristic.

assumptions: Event-date water labels include permanent water; newly flooded land is not separately labelled.
WorldCover 2021 and JRC 1984-2020 are retrospective context for older C2S-MS events.
HAND and TWI are existing nearest-drainage and distance/slope approximations.

Drainage is the existing lowest-2-percentile DEM fallback, used consistently for all inputs; when DEM pixels are missing the percentile uses original finite pixels only, and filled pixels cannot become drainage. Filled DEM pixels and immediate neighbours remain invalid.
Rainfall and delta-SAR channels are omitted unless actually acquired in a separate arm.
Context abstention vetoes WorldCover built-up pixels and a potential-shadow heuristic (slope >=15 degrees, VV <-18 dB, VH <-25 dB); this is not a validated shadow classifier.
No qualified Thai reference exists; no Mae Sai accuracy is claimed.
All outputs are report-only and cannot feed the decision layer.

assumptions: Both dates use terrain-corrected linear gamma0 from the same RTC collection.
C2S-MS sigma0 dB must not be differenced against an RTC reference.
All dates use identical platform, relative orbit, direction and target raster grid.
A 12-48-calendar-day reference is not verified to be flood-free.
